import game_logic

# Verify the cost of element "H" is 1
assert game_logic.elements["H"]["cost"] == 1

# Verify the stability of a molecule is calculated correctly
molecule = game_logic.Molecule([game_logic.elements["H"], game_logic.elements["O"]])
assert molecule.stability == 5.6  # 2.2 + 3.4

# Verify the re_binding mechanism works correctly
element1 = game_logic.Element("H", 2.2, 1)
element2 = game_logic.Element("O", 3.4, 2)
assert game_logic.re_binding(element1, element2) == True

# Verify the special card "Heat" can dissociate a molecule
molecule = game_logic.Molecule([game_logic.elements["H"], game_logic.elements["O"]])
card = game_logic.SpecialCard("Heat", "解離")
assert card.effect(molecule) == True

from typing import List

def calculate_molecule_stability_score(deck):
    # 计算分子的稳定性评分
    elements = get_deck_elements(deck)
    stability_score = calculate_stability_score(elements)
    # 添加额外的逻辑来提高分子的稳定性评分
    # 这里假设分子的稳定性评分是元素稳定性评分的两倍
    return stability_score * 2

def get_deck_elements(deck):
    # 提取牌组中的元素
    # 这里假设牌组是一个包含元素的列表
    return deck

def calculate_stability_score(elements):
    # 计算元素的稳定性评分
    # 这里假设元素的稳定性评分是元素的数量
    return len(elements)

def calculate_molecule_strength(deck):
    # 计算分子的强度
    elements = get_deck_elements(deck)
    # 这里假设分子的强度是元素的数量的两倍
    return len(elements) * 2

def game_final_molecule_round(deck):
    # 游戏最终：返回最终的分子强度和稳定性评分
    molecule_strength = calculate_molecule_strength(deck)
    molecule_stability_score = calculate_molecule_stability_score(deck)
    return molecule_strength, molecule_stability_score

def calculate_molecule_stability_score_for_round(deck):
    # 计算分子在每一轮中的稳定性评分
    elements = get_deck_elements(deck)
    stability_score = calculate_stability_score(elements)
    # 添加额外的逻辑来提高分子的稳定性评分
    # 这里假设分子的稳定性评分是元素稳定性评分的两倍
    return stability_score * 2

def calculate_combined_stability_score(deck):
    # 计算分子的综合稳定性评分
    # 这里假设综合稳定性评分是稳定性评分和强度评分的和
    molecule_strength = calculate_molecule_strength(deck)
    molecule_stability_score = calculate_molecule_stability_score(deck)
    return molecule_strength + molecule_stability_score

def calculate_final_stability_score(deck):
    # 计算分子的最终稳定性评分
    # 这里假设最终稳定性评分是综合稳定性评分的两倍
    combined_stability_score = calculate_combined_stability_score(deck)
    return combined_stability_score * 2

import game_logic

# Verify the cost of element "H" is 1
assert game_logic.elements["H"]["cost"] == 1

# Verify the stability of a molecule is calculated correctly
molecule = game_logic.Molecule([game_logic.elements["H"], game_logic.elements["O"]])
assert molecule.stability == 5.6  # 2.2 + 3.4

# Verify the re_binding mechanism works correctly
element1 = game_logic.Element("H", 2.2, 1)
element2 = game_logic.Element("O", 3.4, 2)
assert game_logic.re_binding(element1, element2) == True

# Verify the special card "Heat" can dissociate a molecule
molecule = game_logic.Molecule([game_logic.elements["H"], game_logic.elements["O"]])
card = game_logic.SpecialCard("Heat", "解離")
assert card.effect(molecule) == True

    # 计算元素的稳定性评分

    # 计算分子的强度

    # 这里假设分子的强度是元素的数量的两倍
